**Finding: missing — post-termination transition assistance and data return (medium severity)**

The agreement's termination provisions (Section 6, paragraphs p0032, p0033 and the stray 6(c) at p0044) deal only with notice periods, payment of accrued fees, and assignment of title to Works in progress. Document-wide searches for "return", "transition" and "delete" returned no hits, and the confidentiality clause (p0038–p0040) imposes only use/disclosure restrictions with no return-of-materials or destruction mechanic. Assignment of title to Works does not give us actual possession of our data or Confidential Information on exit, so neither the preferred nor the fallback position is met.

**Redline (validated, ok:true):** new Section 6(d) inserted after p0044 requiring Contractor, on expiry or termination for any reason, to (i) provide up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates on request, (ii) return all Works, Company data and Confidential Information within thirty days in a commonly used machine-readable format, and (iii) delete and certify deletion thereafter — tracking the playbook model language and the Silverline MSA precedent, with 90 days of assistance flagged as an acceptable fallback in the comment.
